# Xenon Ophthalmics

> The XO Vision Care System — one integrated system for eye care, from
> appointment scheduling through the eye exam, frame fitting, and in-office
> eyewear finishing.

Xenon Ophthalmics builds medtech hardware and software for optometry and
ophthalmology practices. The XO Vision Care System connects four products
into one doctor-led workflow: scheduling, exams, frame fitting, and
finishing, so a patient can walk in and leave with finished eyewear in a
single visit.

## Products

- [xoIris — Scheduling](https://xenon-website-refresh.netlify.app/xoiris-scheduling): Automated booking, patient communication, no-show prediction, and cancellation fill.
- [xoExam — Eye Exam](https://xenon-website-refresh.netlify.app/xoexam-eye-exam): Wearable, medical-grade eye exam platform running 19 doctor-led vision tests.
- [xoFit — Frame Fitting](https://xenon-website-refresh.netlify.app/xofit-frame-fitting): Digital centration and frame measurement across a wall-mounted station, a handheld unit, and a virtual try-on.
- [xoLab — Eyewear Finishing](https://xenon-website-refresh.netlify.app/xolab-eyewear-finishing): In-office frame tracing, blocking, and edging for same-day finished eyewear.
